verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs describe an official Model Context Protocol server that lets developers use natural language from their chosen LLM client to work with Adyen's platform, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. The evidence describes it only at a platform-wide level. Missing for 10: confirmation that the MCP server exposes in-person/Terminal API or terminal-management operations, details on available tools and setup or auth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
